category_description: How income tax, GST and payroll contributions work in Canada.

label: GST rate in a non-participating province
context: Applies to taxable supplies made in a non-participating province.

context: Applies to taxable supplies made in Ontario.

label: HST rate in Nova Scotia
context: Applies to taxable supplies made in Nova Scotia on or after April 1 2025.

label: HST rate in any other participating province
context: Applies to taxable supplies made in a participating province other than Ontario and Nova Scotia.

label: Small supplier limit for GST/HST registration
context: For most businesses. Going over this amount in a single calendar quarter, or over four consecutive calendar quarters, means the business is no longer a small supplier.
